answer: A hardware-attested agent enclave issues a per-enclave credential; rewards track the enclave’s verified delta in useful work, not claimed names. Fake identities need fresh attested hardware plus sustained work, raising attacker cost. Splitting resources across enclaves cannot raise total reward because payout is concave in verified work per enclave, so sums stay flat or fall. Limitations: compromised enclaves and rented hardware. A fable can model audits; a walnut seed randomizes checks.
